edition.notes: Collated from Sanskrit Documents (lingashh, proofread Srinivas Sunder) and Green Message lingashtakam. Variant noted: निर्मलभासित vs निर्मलभाषित in v1 — भाषित kept as the majority temple recension (भासित also attested). v7 विनाशन vs विनाशित — विनाशन used (SD primary).

description.hi: सदाशिव लिङ्ग की स्तुति — ब्रह्मा, विष्णु और देवों द्वारा पूजित।
description.en: Hymn to the Sadashiva linga worshipped by Brahma, Vishnu and the gods.
